answer: Each identity must own one onyx signal lamp at the end of a registered jetty, hand-cranked to flash a coded signal each epoch: the warden logs the pattern and checks it against the lamp's registered code. A lamp costs about $360 in onyx and lamp-work, and the jetty has only a few lamp posts, so each extra fake needs another scarce lamp and pushes the price up; a copied signal fails because the ledger lists every lamp code exactly once.
